name: memory-kit
description: Connects Claude to your company's memory (ai-memory) with the invite you received.
long_description: Memory Kit connects Claude Desktop to your company's ai-memory instance. Paste the private invite you received: it carries the server address, your key and which units you work on. Your key is stored in the system's credential store.

tools.name: memory_kit_whoami
tools.description: Who you are in the company memory and which units you write and read.

invite.title: Convite
invite.description: Cole aqui o convite que você recebeu (começa com aimkit1.). Ele é guardado no cofre de senhas do sistema.
